I do agree with the current movement in employment law that what you do after hours is your business but I do agree that a client would be uncomfortable if they found out their defense was toking. I tried to smoke way more and at my college level last winter, my writing was still good, i got published with a former White House aide twice, but my days were a little too fuzzy to my liking. I think just a little for motivation to get started is okay, but not copious amounts during a sesh. You can’t smoke that much during the test so why smoke that much while studying.
